name: fly-io
description: Wraps official flyctl MCP (flyctl mcp server): apps, machines, logs, certs, secrets, volumes, status, orgs, platform. Requires flyctl on PATH. Not affiliated with Fly.io Inc.

FLY_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: Fly access token
FLY_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Deploy token from Fly dashboard. Set in Cursor plugin variables; not committed. Auth for flyctl MCP via FLY_ACCESS_TOKEN env (or flyctl --access-token).
